helpful: The statpack's CVSG cut and the sal-v2 segment band table lined up cleanly with the frozen context (band, distribution_count, cvsg_date) — the moment-specific anchor was one lookup.
Provisioned full-text petition/BIO/QP made the vehicle analysis possible without any docket PDF fetching.
gaps: fedcourts query has no text or issue-based similarity for SCOTUS rows, so finding 'CVSG'd civil-rights petitions with vehicle problems' as priors is not expressible; a --cvsg or --band filter would have been the natural query for this cell.
--disposition granted matches application dockets whose grant is a time-extension (see flags.json), which pollutes the top-ranked priors.
CourtListener has no opinion text yet for very recent SCOTUS decisions (B.P.J., decided six weeks before this run), so the holding had to come from secondary web coverage.
notes: CVSG-moment cell: the statpack's CVSG cut (grant family ~35.6%) plus the high band's pooled reached rate (~40%) gave a tight anchor pair; most marginal value came from unrestricted forward retrieval on the companion B.P.J./Hecox decisions.
